title: Beyond the Unemployment Rate: A Structural Labor Market Indicator
title_zh: 超越失业率：结构性劳动力市场指标
title_primary: 超越失业率：结构性劳动力市场指标
title_secondary: Beyond the Unemployment Rate: A Structural Labor Market Indicator
authors: Isabel Cairó, Hess Chung, Francesco Ferrante, Cristina Fuentes-Albero, Camilo Morales-Jimenez 等
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Labor market variables frequently send conflicting signals about the degree of slack or tightness, often complicating policy assessments at critical junctures. This paper develops a Structural Labor Market Indicator (SLMI) for the U.S. economy that addresses the limitations of existing univariate measures or atheoretical statistical approaches that synthesize multiple labor market indicators but cannot distinguish between supply and demand driving forces. We construct the SLMI using a medium scale New Keynesian DSGE model featuring search and matching frictions, endogenous labor force participation, and variable hours. The model is disciplined by a comprehensive dataset that includes not only labor market variables but also other macroeconomic aggregates. The SLMI synthesizes model-implied gaps across multiple labor market dimensions using principal component analysis. We show that GDP growth and inflation provide substantial information about labor market slack beyond what labor market variables contain, validating our multi-variable structural approach. Relative to alternative measures, the SLMI often provides earlier warnings of deteriorating conditions at recession onset but recovers more gradually during expansions.
abstract_zh: 劳动力市场变量在衡量松弛或紧张程度时常常发出相互矛盾的信号，这往往在关键时期使政策评估复杂化。本文为美国经济构建了一个结构性劳动力市场指标（SLMI），以解决现有单变量度量或非理论统计方法在综合多个劳动力市场指标时无法区分供给与需求驱动因素的局限性。我们利用一个包含搜索与匹配摩擦、内生劳动力参与率和可变工作时间的中等规模新凯恩斯主义DSGE模型来构建SLMI。该模型受到一个全面数据集的约束，该数据集不仅包括劳动力市场变量，还包括其他宏观经济总量。SLMI通过主成分分析综合了模型隐含的多个劳动力市场维度缺口。我们表明，GDP增长和通胀提供了超越劳动力市场变量本身所含信息的关于劳动力市场松弛的大量信息，验证了我们的多变量结构性方法。与其他替代指标相比，SLMI往往在经济衰退初期更早发出状况恶化的预警，但在扩张期间恢复则更为缓慢。

title: Conformity and silence: Experimental evidence on social pressure and free speech
title_zh: 从众与沉默：关于社会压力与言论自由的实验证据

authors: Juan S. Morales, Margaret Samahita
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the public expression of opinions on polarized topics (race and gender). In a series of pre-registered online experiments conducted in the United States in 2021 and 2023, we elicited participants’ views on these topics and their willingness to publish their views online. We find an asymmetric U-shaped relationship between ideological stance and willingness to share views publicly: moderates were least willing to speak up, willingness rose toward both ideological extremes and was highest among respondents with progressive views. Participants also perceived publicly expressed opinions as more left-leaning than underlying private opinions. A priming treatment highlighting the risk of negative social media backlash had modest and statistically insignificant effects. A social-information treatment informing respondents that many others were willing to speak up significantly reduced self-censorship.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在极化议题（种族与性别）上公众意见的表达。通过2021年和2023年在美国进行的一系列预注册在线实验，我们收集了参与者对这些议题的看法及其在线公开发表意见的意愿。我们发现，意识形态立场与公开发表意见意愿之间存在不对称的U型关系：温和派最不愿发声，意愿向意识形态两端递增，且在持进步观点的受访者中最高。参与者还认为，公开表达的意见比私下意见更偏左。一项强调社交媒体负面反弹风险的启动处理效应较小且统计上不显著。一项告知受访者许多其他人愿意发声的社会信息处理显著减少了自我审查。

title: A City of God: Afterlife Beliefs and Job Support in Brazil
title_zh: 上帝之城：来世信仰与巴西就业支持
title_primary: 上帝之城：来世信仰与巴西就业支持
title_secondary: A City of God: Afterlife Beliefs and Job Support in Brazil
authors: Tiago Cavalcanti, Sriya Iyer, Christopher Rauh, Christian Roerig, Maryam Vaziri
official: 官方在线 2022-12-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using primary data from Brazil in 2019-2020, we quantify the link between reli- gion, expectations and economic outcomes, suggesting a key complementarity that for religious networks to provide insurance in this life one also needs strong beliefs in the afterlife. Individuals invest more in their religious communities if they can also expect various forms of community support. The degree of this insurance channel varies across different religions and is highest for Pentecostals. Consistent with this, we build a lifecycle model with heterogeneous agents, imperfect insurance and afterlife beliefs. We discipline the value of model parameters with our data and show that under certain parameterizations the job support channel exists as a by-product of coordinated beliefs in the afterlife. Our results provide evidence that insurance by the community would not be enough to induce religious investments. It is complementarity with beliefs in the afterlife which raises the returns of religious investments above the threshold. The community support and afterlife channel together provide an average value worth 9.6% of consumption in each year.
abstract_zh: 利用2019-2020年巴西的原始数据，我们量化了宗教、预期与经济结果之间的联系，提出了一种关键的互补性：宗教网络若要在此生提供保障，还需伴随对来世的坚定信念。个体若预期能获得各种形式的社区支持，便会更多投资于其宗教社群。这一保险渠道的程度在不同宗教间存在差异，其中五旬节派最高。与此一致，我们构建了一个包含异质主体、不完全保险及来世信念的生命周期模型。我们利用数据校准模型参数值，并表明在特定参数设定下，工作支持渠道作为来世信念协调一致的副产品而存在。我们的研究结果表明，仅凭社区的保险不足以诱发宗教投资，正是与来世信念的互补性将宗教投资的回报提升至阈值以上。社区支持与来世渠道共同提供的年均价值相当于消费的9.6%。

title: Openness, Integration, and the International Monetary Order
title_zh: 开放、一体化与国际货币秩序
title_primary: 开放、一体化与国际货币秩序
title_secondary: Openness, Integration, and the International Monetary Order
authors: Tarek Hassan, Thomas Mertens, Jingye Wang, Tony Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a calibrated general-equilibrium model to study how different configurations of trade and financial policy reshape the hierarchy of global currencies --- and the U.S. dollar's position at its anchor. Currency safety and anchor status arise endogenously from each economy's 'effective size' — the weight its domestic shocks carry in setting world prices. Tariffs reduce this effective size on the goods side; capital controls do the same on the financial side. A unifying result emerges: The economy that maintains the deepest integration with the global trading network retains the largest safety premium and gains anchor status. We use this framework to evaluate the effects of three policy levers for Europe that affect the effective size of the euro: internal harmonization and enlargement, trade openness, and capital-account openness. The stakes are large: In our model, shifts in currencies' safety can redirect global capital flows and alter sovereign borrowing costs by hundreds of billions of dollars annually.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个校准的一般均衡模型，用以研究贸易与金融政策的不同配置如何重塑全球货币的层级结构——以及美元在其锚定位置上的地位。货币的安全性与锚定地位内生于各经济体的“有效规模”——即其国内冲击在世界价格决定中所占的权重。关税在商品层面削弱了这一有效规模；资本管制则在金融层面产生相同效应。一个统一的结果由此显现：与全球贸易网络保持最深层次融合的经济体，将保留最大的安全溢价并赢得锚定地位。我们利用这一框架评估了影响欧元有效规模的三个欧洲政策杠杆的效果：内部协调与扩大、贸易开放度以及资本账户开放度。其影响重大：在我们的模型中，货币安全性的变动可引导全球资本流动，并每年改变主权借贷成本达数千亿美元。

title: Critical Values Robust to P-hacking
title_zh: 抗p-hacking的临界值
title_primary: 抗p-hacking的临界值
title_secondary: Critical Values Robust to P-hacking
authors: Adam McCloskey, Pascal Michaillat
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: P-hacking is prevalent in reality but absent from classical hypothesis-testing theory. We therefore build a model of hypothesis testing that accounts for p-hacking. From the model, we derive critical values such that, if they are used to determine significance, and if p-hacking adjusts to the new significance standards, then spurious significant results do not occur more often than intended. Because of p-hacking, such robust critical values are larger than classical critical values. In the model calibrated to medical science, the robust critical value is the classical critical value for the same test statistic but with one-fifth of the significance level.
abstract_zh: P-hacking在现实中普遍存在，但经典假设检验理论却未将其纳入考量。为此，我们构建了一个考虑P-hacking的假设检验模型。基于该模型，我们推导出临界值：若以此临界值判定统计显著性，且P-hacking行为随新的显著性标准调整，则虚假显著结果的出现频率不会超过预期水平。由于P-hacking的存在，此类稳健临界值大于经典临界值。在基于医学科学校准的模型中，稳健临界值相当于同一检验统计量在显著性水平降至五分之一时的经典临界值。

title: Did the United States Really Grow Out of Its World War II Debt?
title_zh: 美国真的通过经济增长摆脱了二战债务吗？

authors: Julien Acalin, Laurence Ball
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-06-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the effects of primary budget surpluses, surprise inflation, and pegged interest rates before the Fed-Treasury Accord of 1951 on the US public debt/GDP ratio. We find that with the primary budget balance and without distortions in real interest rates caused by surprise inflation and the pre-Accord peg, debt/GDP would have declined only from 106 percent in 1946 to 74 percent in 1974, not to 23 percent as in actual history. Our findings imply that, over the last 76 years, only a small amount of debt reduction has been achieved through growth rates that exceed undistorted interest rates. (JEL E23, E31, E43, E65, H61, H63, N12)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了1951年美联储-财政部协议前，初级预算盈余、意外通胀及钉住利率对美国公共债务/GDP比率的影响。研究发现，若保持初级预算平衡且避免因意外通胀及协议前利率钉住导致的实际利率扭曲，债务/GDP比率仅会从1946年的106%降至1974年的74%，而非实际历史中的23%。我们的结论表明，过去76年间，通过增长率超过未扭曲利率实现的债务削减规模极小。(JEL E23, E31, E43, E65, H61, H63, N12)

title: From urban renewal to urban–rural renewal: exploring new paths for integrated urban–rural development in China
title_zh: 从城市更新到城乡更新：探索中国城乡融合发展的新路径
title_primary: 从城市更新到城乡更新：探索中国城乡融合发展的新路径
title_secondary: From urban renewal to urban–rural renewal: exploring new paths for integrated urban–rural development in China
authors: Chengyou Li, Chuanlei Ji, Zeru Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Integrated urban–rural development (IURD) is an essential requirement for China’s modernization. As a key driver of IURD, urban renewal plays a vital role; therefore, assessing its impact on this process is of great significance. Using panel data from 274 prefecture-level and above cities in China covering 2007–2022, we construct composite indices via the entropy method and employ a two-way fixed-effects model to examine how urban renewal affects IURD. The findings indicate that (1) Urban renewal significantly promotes IURD, a result that remains robust across a battery of robustness checks. (2) The impact of urban renewal on IURD varies across geographic accessibility, urban hierarchy and city size. (3) Urban renewal not only directly influences IURD but also exerts indirect effects by facilitating population mobility and curbing urban sprawl. This study supplements theoretical mechanisms and empirical evidence regarding the impact of urban renewal on IURD, providing policy implications for advancing IURD.
abstract_zh: 城乡融合发展是中国式现代化的必然要求。城市更新作为城乡融合发展的关键驱动力，评估其对这一进程的影响具有重要意义。基于2007—2022年中国274个地级及以上城市的面板数据，采用熵值法构建综合指数，并运用双向固定效应模型考察城市更新对城乡融合发展的影响。研究发现：（1）城市更新显著促进城乡融合发展，该结果在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。（2）城市更新对城乡融合发展的影响因地理可达性、城市等级和城市规模而异。（3）城市更新不仅直接影响城乡融合发展，还通过促进人口流动和抑制城市蔓延产生间接效应。本研究补充了城市更新影响城乡融合发展的理论机制与实证证据，为推进城乡融合发展提供了政策启示。

title: Asset price bubbles and systemic risk in money market funds
title_zh: 资产价格泡沫与货币市场基金的系统性风险
title_primary: 资产价格泡沫与货币市场基金的系统性风险
title_secondary: Asset price bubbles and systemic risk in money market funds
authors: Matteo Aquilina, Peter Cincinelli, Giovanni Urga
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate the systemic risk contribution of 3, 500 Money Market Funds (MMFs) in normal periods and during asset price bubbles in the US from January 2004 to December 2022. Using state-of-the-art statistical techniques for bubble detection and granular fund-level data, we show that MMF characteristics significantly influence systemic risk. Large MMFs and government MMFs, which invest exclusively in US Treasury securities, are associated with reduced systemic risk, while prime MMFs contribute to higher systemic risk. MMFs denominated in US dollars but domiciled offshore exhibit no significant differences from their US-domiciled counterparts.
abstract_zh: 本文以2004年1月至2022年12月美国3,500只货币市场基金为样本，系统考察其在常态时期与资产价格泡沫期间的系统性风险贡献。运用前沿泡沫检测统计技术与基金层面微观数据，研究发现货币市场基金特征对系统性风险具有显著影响。大型货币市场基金及仅投资于美国国债的政府型货币市场基金与较低的系统性风险相关，而优质型货币市场基金则加剧系统性风险。以美元计价但注册于离岸市场的货币市场基金，其系统性风险水平与在岸基金无显著差异。

title: DP21630 Publication Bias and P-Hacking in the Effect of COVID-19 on Learning
title_zh: 新冠疫情对学习影响的发表偏倚与P值操纵
title_primary: 新冠疫情对学习影响的发表偏倚与P值操纵
title_secondary: DP21630 Publication Bias and P-Hacking in the Effect of COVID-19 on Learning
authors: Martina Luskova, Nino Buliskeria, Ali Elminejad, Tomas Havranek, Zuzana Irsova 等
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We revisit a central estimate in the economics of education: the human-capital loss associated with COVID-19 school closures. Estimates of pandemic learning loss may be affected by publication bias, p-hacking, and the mechanical correlation between standardized effect sizes and their standard errors. We conduct a comprehensive multi-method assessment of bias by applying a wide range of correction techniques, including PET-PEESE, three-parameter selection models (3PSM), Robust Bayesian Meta-Analysis (RoBMA), Meta-Analysis Instrumental Variable Estimation (MAIVE), Right-Truncated Meta-Analysis (RTMA), and multi-bias sensitivity analysis. Our preferred specifications, RoBMA and MAIVE, rely on different assumptions yet converge on an effect size of approximately −0.12 SD, equivalent to a learning loss of about 30% of a school year. Although some methods reveal signs of publication bias and selective reporting, these findings do not explain away the central finding: the COVID-19 learning deficit is economically meaningful and statistically robust.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视教育经济学中的一个核心估计：与新冠疫情学校关闭相关的人力资本损失。对疫情学习损失的估计可能受到发表偏倚、p值操纵以及标准化效应量与其标准误之间机械相关性的影响。我们通过应用多种修正技术，包括PET-PEESE、三参数选择模型（3PSM）、稳健贝叶斯元分析（RoBMA）、元分析工具变量估计（MAIVE）、右截断元分析（RTMA）以及多偏倚敏感性分析，对偏倚进行了全面的多方法评估。我们偏好的设定——RoBMA和MAIVE——基于不同假设，但均收敛于约−0.12个标准差的效应量，相当于约一个学年30%的学习损失。尽管部分方法显示出发表偏倚和选择性报告的证据，但这些发现并未否定核心结论：新冠疫情导致的学习赤字在经济上具有显著意义，且在统计上稳健。

title: How voters choose under the Borda rule: evidence from a post-election survey experiment in Germany 2025
title_zh: 博尔达规则下选民如何选择：来自德国2025年选举后调查实验的证据
title_primary: 博尔达规则下选民如何选择：来自德国2025年选举后调查实验的证据
title_secondary: How voters choose under the Borda rule: evidence from a post-election survey experiment in Germany 2025
authors: Anna-Sophie Kurella
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Borda count offers a promising alternative to counteract the growing polarization of party systems by incentivizing moderate party strategies. However, empirical evidence on the Borda count is still lacking. This paper presents results from an online survey conducted in the aftermath of the 2025 German federal election, in which respondents were asked for their vote choice under a Borda count system. Participants were randomly assigned to one of two conditions: in the first, they could rank up to three out of seven parties; in the second, they could rank all seven parties. The findings show that more ranks considered, the more fragmented the election result. It also shows that the Borda count has mixed effects on policy congruence between voters and parliament. Respondents’ overall acceptance of the Borda rule was moderate to negative, with many of the objections cited were based on misconceptions about the system’s consequences.
abstract_zh: 波达计数法通过激励政党采取温和策略，为应对政党体系日益加剧的两极分化提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，关于波达计数法的实证证据仍然匮乏。本文基于2025年德国联邦大选后开展的一项在线调查，呈现了受访者在波达计数法下的投票选择结果。参与者被随机分配到两种情境之一：第一种情境中，他们最多可对七个政党中的三个进行排序；第二种情境中，他们可对所有七个政党进行排序。研究结果表明，可排序的政党数量越多，选举结果越分散。同时，波达计数法对选民与议会之间的政策一致性产生了混合效应。受访者对波达规则的整体接受度处于中等偏负面水平，且许多反对意见源于对该制度后果的误解。

title: Re-doing the audit
title_zh: 重新进行审计
title_primary: 重新进行审计
title_secondary: Re-doing the audit
authors: Isabel J. Cho, Clive Lennox, Xiangyu Li
official: 官方在线 2026-06-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates the practice of re-audits—where an incoming audit firm re-audits the prior year’s financial statements previously examined by a predecessor audit firm. We examine the costs and benefits of such re-audits. We find that re-audits are more likely when the risks of misstatement are high and when incoming auditors can expect to win more clients by identifying material misstatements overlooked by predecessor auditors. Our results show that incoming auditors who perform re-audits are more successful in winning new clients from predecessor auditors. Moreover, re-audits result in significantly more restatements. However, consistent with the resource-intensive nature of re-audits, we also find that they are associated with longer audit delays and higher audit fees. Overall, we conclude that re-audits have important consequences for financial statement users, incoming auditors, and predecessor auditors.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了重新审计的实践——即新接任的审计事务所对前任审计事务所先前审查过的上一年度财务报表进行再次审计。我们考察了此类重新审计的成本与效益。研究发现，当错报风险较高，且新接任审计师预期通过识别前任审计师遗漏的重大错报而赢得更多客户时，重新审计更可能发生。结果显示，执行重新审计的新接任审计师在从前任审计师处争取新客户方面更为成功。此外，重新审计显著增加了重述的发生。然而，与重新审计的资源密集型特性相一致，我们也发现其与更长的审计延迟和更高的审计费用相关联。总体而言，我们得出结论，重新审计对财务报表使用者、新接任审计师及前任审计师均具有重要影响。

title: Natural disaster and intergenerational occupational choice in agriculture: Evidence from the US Dust Bowl
title_zh: 自然灾害与农业代际职业选择：来自美国沙尘暴的证据
title_primary: 自然灾害与农业代际职业选择：来自美国沙尘暴的证据
title_secondary: Natural disaster and intergenerational occupational choice in agriculture: Evidence from the US Dust Bowl
authors: Jhih‐Yun Liu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how a natural disaster, the Dust Bowl, shapes occupational choices in farm households across generations. Using full‐count US census data, I find that young adult sons shift away from self‐employed farming toward wage farm work and nonagricultural sectors after the Dust Bowl. Younger children with affected farming parents are more likely to leave agriculture and earn higher income. Migration and schooling serve as mechanisms, and New Deal relief spending mitigates the Dust Bowl's effects. Overall, the Dust Bowl accelerated occupational reallocation among younger children of farmers and contributed to US mid‐20th century structural change.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了自然灾害“沙尘暴”如何跨代塑造农户家庭的职业选择。利用美国人口普查全量数据，我发现沙尘暴后，年轻成年儿子从自营农业转向雇佣农业劳动和非农部门。受影响的农民家庭中，年幼子女更可能离开农业并获得更高收入。迁移与教育是作用机制，而新政救济支出缓解了沙尘暴的影响。总体而言，沙尘暴加速了农民年轻子女的职业再配置，并推动了美国20世纪中期的结构性变革。

title: Farmland Liquidity Under a Tightened Ownership Regime: Urban–Rural Heterogeneity in South Korea
title_zh: 收紧所有权制度下的农地流动性：韩国的城乡异质性
title_primary: 收紧所有权制度下的农地流动性：韩国的城乡异质性
title_secondary: Farmland Liquidity Under a Tightened Ownership Regime: Urban–Rural Heterogeneity in South Korea
authors: Jiseon Choi, Gwangseok Chae
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In real estate markets featuring substantial search friction and strong seller loss aversion, external shocks that shift buyer valuations are largely reflected in liquidity fluctuations, while price adjustments tend to be rigid. This study examines market liquidity shifts following the tightening of South Korean farmland ownership regulations, utilizing the 2021 Farmland Act amendment and nationwide parcel‐level transaction data (2013−2023). We estimate the relationships between land liquidity, policy change, and key macro variables (i.e. interest rates) using a monthly county fixed‐effects model. We find that the amendment is significantly associated with a 10%−11% reduction in nationwide market liquidity, as measured by the turnover rate. This negative relationship is geographically heterogeneous, being more pronounced in rural areas while statistically insignificant in investment‐driven urban areas. Furthermore, our decomposition analysis reveals that the post‐enforcement drop in observed market liquidity is mostly associated with rising interest rates. The role of interest rates is more dominant in urbanized areas than rural ones, reflecting the higher concentration of investment‐driven buyers and substantial capital requirements for land acquisition in these regions. Our findings demonstrate that the market response to ownership regulation is strongly mediated by local market conditions, highlighting the challenges of enforcing stringent policies in areas with high investment potential.
abstract_zh: 在具有显著搜索摩擦和强烈卖方损失厌恶特征的房地产市场中，改变买方估值的外部冲击主要反映在流动性波动上，而价格调整往往呈现刚性。本研究利用2021年《农地法》修正案及2013-2023年全国地块层面交易数据，考察韩国农地所有权监管收紧后的市场流动性变化。我们采用月度县级固定效应模型，估计土地流动性、政策变化与关键宏观变量（如利率）之间的关系。研究发现，该修正案与全国市场流动性（以周转率衡量）显著下降10%-11%相关。这种负向关系存在地理异质性：在农村地区更为显著，而在投资驱动的城市地区统计上不显著。此外，分解分析表明，政策实施后观察到的市场流动性下降主要与利率上升相关。利率在城市化地区的作用比农村地区更为突出，这反映了这些地区投资驱动型买家的高度集中以及土地收购所需的大量资本。我们的研究结果表明，市场对所有权监管的反应受到当地市场条件的强烈调节，凸显了在高投资潜力地区实施严格政策的挑战。

title: Exploring heterogeneity and asymmetries in transfer pricing: evidence from Finland
title_zh: 探索转让定价中的异质性与非对称性：来自芬兰的证据
title_primary: 探索转让定价中的异质性与非对称性：来自芬兰的证据
title_secondary: Exploring heterogeneity and asymmetries in transfer pricing: evidence from Finland
authors: Marika Viertola
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper utilizes detailed transaction-destination-level data from Finland for years 2013-2019 to examine how multinational enterprises adjust transfer prices to shift profit from high tax countries to low tax countries. Employing a triple difference strategy that leverages variations in corporate income tax rates and affiliate ownership, I provide robust evidence that multinational enterprises underprice exports to low tax destinations. Additionally, my findings suggest that transfer pricing serves as a complementary channel of profit shifting, as firms more prone to other profit shifting mechanisms also underprice their exports more. Furthermore, I provide evidence that firms with more affiliates as well as firms with tax haven affiliates transfer misprice more. My results also suggest asymmetries: while there is clear evidence of transfer mispricing in exports to low tax destinations, there is no consistent evidence of transfer mispricing in imports.
abstract_zh: 本文利用芬兰2013-2019年间详细的交易目的地层面数据，考察跨国企业如何调整转让定价以将利润从高税国家转移至低税国家。通过采用三重差分策略，利用企业所得税税率及关联企业所有权的差异，我提供了有力证据表明跨国企业对低税目的地的出口存在定价偏低现象。此外，研究结果显示，转让定价作为利润转移的补充渠道，那些更倾向于采用其他利润转移机制的企业，其出口定价偏低程度也更大。进一步地，我证明拥有更多关联企业以及设有避税天堂关联企业的公司，其转让定价偏差更为显著。研究结果还揭示了不对称性：尽管对低税目的地的出口存在明确的转让定价偏差证据，但在进口方面并未发现一致的转让定价偏差证据。

title: Choice experiments on land managers' participation in environmental programs: A systematic review and meta‐analysis of estimate validity
title_zh: 土地管理者参与环境项目的选择实验：估计有效性的系统综述与元分析
title_primary: 土地管理者参与环境项目的选择实验：估计有效性的系统综述与元分析
title_secondary: Choice experiments on land managers' participation in environmental programs: A systematic review and meta‐analysis of estimate validity
authors: Anastasio J. Villanueva, Angel Perni, Jesus Barreiro‐Hurle
official: 官方在线 2026-04-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Discrete choice experiments are increasingly being used to estimate land managers' willingness to accept participation in incentive‐based environmental programs. This is a specific application of discrete choice experiments: the estimation of willingness to accept for a private good (program participation) where respondents have to make trade‐offs between payments and the business costs required to improve the provision of the (environmental) public good targeted by the program. Previous reviews fail to provide methodological insights into the use of discrete choice experiments in this valuation context. In this study, we conduct a review of 80 studies (containing up to 93 sample‐based observations) published in the Web of Science Core Collection, all of which apply discrete choice experiments to examine land managers' (farmers' and foresters') willingness to accept for participating in incentive‐based environmental programs. Based on this systematic review, we report quantitative information on key features regarding policy settings, experiment design and implementation, and willingness to accept results. We conclude that many of the analyzed studies do not follow best practices for discrete choice experiments in particular and stated preference methods in general. We also use a construct validity indicator to assess whether willingness to accept estimates align with expectations about land managers' utility. The results from the meta‐analysis show that special care should be taken in applications that focus on Africa, include contract design attributes, and use in‐person surveys, among other features. Recommendations are provided to enable practitioners to obtain more accurate welfare estimates for better policy‐making support.
abstract_zh: 摘要 离散选择实验日益被用于估算土地管理者参与激励型环境项目的接受意愿。这是离散选择实验的一种特定应用：估算对私人商品（项目参与）的接受意愿，其中受访者必须在支付金额与改善项目所针对的（环境）公共物品供给所需的经营成本之间进行权衡。以往的综述未能为这一估值情境下离散选择实验的使用提供方法论见解。在本研究中，我们对Web of Science核心合集收录的80项研究（包含多达93个基于样本的观测值）进行了综述，这些研究均应用离散选择实验来考察土地管理者（农民和林务人员）参与激励型环境项目的接受意愿。基于这一系统性综述，我们报告了关于政策设定、实验设计与实施以及接受意愿结果等关键特征的定量信息。我们得出结论，许多被分析的研究并未遵循离散选择实验的最佳实践，总体上也未遵循陈述偏好方法的最佳实践。我们还使用构念效度指标来评估接受意愿估计值是否与土地管理者效用的预期一致。元分析结果表明，在聚焦非洲、包含合同设计属性以及使用面对面调查等特征的应用中，应特别谨慎。我们提供了相关建议，以帮助实践者获得更准确的福利估计，从而更好地支持政策制定。

title: Women's wages and empowerment: Pre‐industrial Japan, 1600–1890
title_zh: 女性工资与赋权：前工业化时期的日本，1600–1890
title_primary: 女性工资与赋权：前工业化时期的日本，1600–1890
title_secondary: Women's wages and empowerment: Pre‐industrial Japan, 1600–1890
authors: Yuzuru Kumon, Kazuho Sakai
official: 官方在线 2026-02-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using new evidence from servant contracts, 1600–1890, we estimate women's wages in Japan. Women's wages could only sustain 1.3–2.3 people up to 1900, the lowest recorded in the pre‐industrial world. We then show that the gender wage ratio was 0.75, higher than in Western Europe. Despite this, Japan had lower female empowerment for two reasons. First, absolute wages were low, so women struggled to be independent. Second, landownership incomes were mostly earned by men, raising their bargaining positions. The low female empowerment in Japan could explain the early and universal marriage of its women, unlike their empowered Western European counterparts.
abstract_zh: 利用1600至1890年间仆役合同的新证据，我们估算了日本女性的工资水平。直至1900年，女性工资仅能维持1.3至2.3人的生活，这是前工业时代有记录以来的最低水平。我们进一步揭示，性别工资比率为0.75，高于西欧。尽管如此，日本女性的赋权程度较低，原因有二：首先，绝对工资水平低，导致女性难以独立；其次，土地所有权收入主要由男性获得，增强了他们的谈判地位。日本女性赋权程度低，或可解释其女性早婚且普遍结婚的现象，这与西欧赋权程度较高的女性形成鲜明对比。

title: Do Export‐Driven ICT Investments Boost Firm Performance? Empirical Insights From Indian Manufacturing
title_zh: 出口驱动的ICT投资能否提升企业绩效？来自印度制造业的经验证据
title_primary: 出口驱动的ICT投资能否提升企业绩效？来自印度制造业的经验证据
title_secondary: Do Export‐Driven ICT Investments Boost Firm Performance? Empirical Insights From Indian Manufacturing
authors: Nitika Arneja, Chandan Sharma
official: 官方在线 2026-02-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The literature on learning‐by‐exporting has largely overlooked the role of information and communication technology (ICT). Given the growing importance of this issue, this study examines whether firms' entry into export markets induces additional ICT investments and how such investments influence performance. Using firm‑level data from India for 2002–2019, the analysis applies a two‑step method: propensity score matching (PSM) to identify export‑driven ICT spending, followed by production function estimation to evaluate its effects. The results show that exporting leads firms to raise their ICT spending, and that this export‑driven component is associated with larger gains in value‐added than the counterfactual ICT spending. Further evidence indicates that export‑driven ICT expenditures support capital formation, and the resulting ICT capital stocks yield higher gains than their counterfactuals. At the sectoral level, less ICT‑intensive industries benefit more from ICT expenditure flows, whereas highly ICT‑intensive industries gain more from ICT capital stocks. Robustness checks based on direct productivity analysis and the PSM difference‑in‑differences approach confirm these findings. Taken together, the evidence highlights the importance of integrated policies that align digital investment strategies with export support initiatives.
abstract_zh: 关于“出口中学”的文献在很大程度上忽视了信息与通信技术（ICT）的作用。鉴于这一问题日益重要，本研究探讨企业进入出口市场是否引发额外的ICT投资，以及此类投资如何影响企业绩效。利用2002年至2019年印度企业层面的数据，分析采用两步法：首先运用倾向得分匹配（PSM）识别由出口驱动的ICT支出，随后通过生产函数估计评估其效应。结果显示，出口促使企业增加ICT支出，且这一由出口驱动的部分相较于反事实ICT支出，能带来更大的增加值收益。进一步证据表明，出口驱动的ICT支出支持资本形成，由此产生的ICT资本存量相较于反事实情形带来更高收益。在行业层面，ICT密集度较低的行业从ICT支出流中获益更多，而ICT密集度较高的行业则从ICT资本存量中获益更多。基于直接生产率分析和PSM双重差分法的稳健性检验证实了上述发现。综合来看，这些证据凸显了将数字投资战略与出口支持举措相结合的综合政策的重要性。

title: State Ownership and Firm R&D Performance: Objectives or Capabilities?
title_zh: 国有所有权与企业研发绩效：目标还是能力？
title_primary: 国有所有权与企业研发绩效：目标还是能力？
title_secondary: State Ownership and Firm R&D Performance: Objectives or Capabilities?
authors: Yang Ming, Meng Wu
official: 官方在线 2025-12-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Although numerous studies compare the R&D performance of state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and nonstate-owned enterprises (NSOEs), few investigate the underlying mechanisms. Using a novel data set on the market value of patents held by Chinese publicly listed firms, we find that SOEs generate lower private economic value from innovation than NSOEs, while the scientific value of their innovations does not differ significantly. Our analysis suggests that the ownership-related gap in R&D performance arises more from differences in firm objectives than from differences in capabilities. Specifically, SOEs exhibit weaker profit-seeking incentives, which lead to lower private returns on innovation. These findings imply that SOEs' R&D activities generate greater positive externalities than those of NSOEs, underscoring the distinctive social contributions of SOE innovation and its nonsubstitutability by NSOE innovation.
abstract_zh: 尽管已有大量研究比较了国有企业与非国有企业在研发绩效上的差异，但鲜有研究深入探讨其背后的机制。利用一项关于中国上市公司所持专利市场价值的新数据集，我们发现国有企业从创新中获得的私人经济价值低于非国有企业，而两者创新的科学价值并无显著差异。我们的分析表明，所有制相关的研发绩效差距更多源于企业目标的不同，而非能力的差异。具体而言，国有企业表现出较弱的利润追求激励，这导致其创新带来的私人回报较低。这些发现意味着，国有企业的研发活动相比非国有企业产生了更大的正外部性，凸显了国有企业创新的独特社会贡献及其非国有企业创新所不可替代的特性。
